result:
I fixed the audit warning on `PostController.store`. `bun run typecheck` still passes, and `bunx guren audit` no longer mentions `PostController` or `force*`. I haven't run the tests or the full `bunx guren gate`.

`store` now creates the post with `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })` instead of `forceCreate`, so the author always comes from the signed-in user. To make that work, I took `authorId` out of `Post`'s `fillable` list in `app/Models/Post.ts`. `store` and `update` now also drop any `authorId` sent in the request body before writing. A client can't set or change a post's author, and an `authorId` in the request no longer throws a mass-assignment error.

`bunx guren audit` still reports 1 failure and 1 warning. The failure is the `source-map-js` advisory on a dependency (the output was cut off, so I didn't see the warning). Neither is from this change, so I left them.
